issues.description: ELF loader omitted allocated sections and assumed section bases.
issues.fix: Load ELF32 RISC-V PT_LOAD segments at their addresses; zero-fill p_memsz; reject invalid, overlapping and out-of-window segments.

issues.description: Store width mutation could pass comparison; native observation was modified in place.
issues.fix: Read native width independently from the preceding cycle; compare widths explicitly; mask native bus data using native width without mutating it.

issues.description: A valid jump at PC 4092 fails on its speculative fallthrough fetch at 4096 before flushing.
issues.fix: Carry fetch faults through IF/ID and ID/EX; assert only when the fault survives flush and reaches EX; guard ROM indexing.

issues.description: A store followed immediately by string ECALL prints A in the model/oracle and an empty string in native Ripes; sampling order unresolved.
issues.fix: Native adapter captures pre-edge ECALL arguments and completes output after the edge, after older stores commit. Exit finalization remains pre-edge; reference CPU unchanged.
